description: This file defines the class JacksonDeserializerAdapter, which is a custom implementation of Jackson's JsonDeserializer. It adapts a JsonConverter to be used as a Jackson deserializer for specific types, facilitating custom deserialization logic within a Jersey-based REST API context.

classes.name: JacksonDeserializerAdapter
classes.description: A generic adapter class that extends Jackson's JsonDeserializer to use a custom JsonConverter for deserialization.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Overrides the JsonDeserializer's deserialize method to convert JSON input into an object of type T using the provided JsonConverter.

methods.name: handledType
methods.description: Returns the class type that this deserializer can handle, as provided by the JsonConverter.
